purpose: Retrospective, hash-bound evaluator-Oracle diagnostic over already frozen autonomous winner-only observations. It must not reopen P8BP, add visual rounds, or train a router.

method.vote_source: three already frozen independently masked winner-only rounds
method.oracle_choice: For each source, choose physical only when its observed winner count is strictly greater than the global AO6 count; ties fall back to AO6.
method.oracle_score: Sum the observed winner counts of the selected arm across sources.
method.global_score: Sum the observed AO6 winner counts across sources.
method.censor_rule: B0-winning rounds expose neither the AO6-versus-physical runner-up ordering nor a pairwise preference and remain censored; they must not be imputed.
method.fresh_role: retrospective product-value diagnostic only, not a preregistered confirmatory test

branch_rule.pass: Retain only an evaluator-Oracle research gap; separately preregister complete pairwise evidence before any selector or router.
branch_rule.fail: Close routing for the frozen physical arm and retain AO6 as the simpler global colour champion.
branch_rule.censored: No router opens. Record that winner-only evidence cannot establish pairwise Oracle value.

forbidden: threshold change after reading the report
stock, process, scanner, calibration, or population-preference claim
claim_ceiling: Retrospective autonomous winner-only evaluator-Oracle diagnostic on two frozen nine-image development/fresh populations. B0-winning fresh rounds are censored; this is not complete pairwise Oracle evidence, population preference, stock response, calibration, or product promotion.
